LOG.TITLE: Action log ({{count}} entries)
LOG.TRUNCATED: ⚠️ The log hit its 20 000-entry cap and was cut short — this run is longer than the log can hold.
LOG.INTEGRITY_OK: ✅ No player took more than one round-costing action in any round.
LOG.INTEGRITY_BAD: ❌ A player acted twice in one round — rounds: {{rounds}}
LOG.HAND_HINT: Coins and cards in hand are the values right after the action. Use them to check the arithmetic: a buy is +1 card, a produce is +1 card, a death resets the hand to a fresh deal.
LOG.SEARCH_HINT: Search is not a choice. It is what the round becomes when the player could neither buy nor take a credit — the detail column says which wall they hit:

REASON.NOTMET: met nobody holding it — someone in the game has it, just not among the players met this round
REASON.REFUSED: met a holder, but they are hoarding that same recipe
REASON.BROKE: met a willing seller asking {{price}}, but held only {{coins}}
REASON.NOWHERE: no living player holds it at all — those copies are stranded in the deck
REASON.COMPLETE: nothing left to chase — the hand is already a finished recipe that cannot be produced

NOTE.TITLE: How it is calculated
NOTE.COST_BUY: Buy a card from someone met this round
NOTE.COST_SEARCH: Search — met nobody holding what is needed
NOTE.COST_CREDIT: Ask the animator for a credit (a negotiation)
NOTE.FREE_PRODUCE: Produce — a solo action on the player's own device; cascades
NOTE.FREE_SELL: Sell — the buyer spent the round
NOTE.FREE_SETTLE: Settle a credit or pay interest (unilateral)
NOTE.FREE_DEATH: Death and reincarnation — it happens to the player
NOTE.F_ROUNDS: the round is the unit of time
NOTE.F_TEMPERATURE_BODY: (productions ÷ players ÷ rounds) ÷ 0.0886 — the baseline being an observed 14-player game: 62 productions over 50 rounds.
NOTE.C_TECH: Never reached the unimplemented technological shift
NOTE.C_DEADLOCK: A latent square existed in every round
NOTE.C_EVERYONE: Every avatar produced at least once
NOTE.C_STRANDED: Stranded share never passed the ceiling
NOTE.C_TEMPERATURE: Tempo stayed within ×{{tolerance}} of the baseline
NOTE.TEMP_HOT: Too abundant: squares complete without negotiation, production cascades, the upper decks drain and the technological shift arrives early — where the game currently throws.
NOTE.TEMP_COLD: Too scarce: players idle, latent squares vanish, the stranded share climbs, and players go to the animator asking why their card is nowhere to be found.

HINT.MODEL: Calibrated against an observed 14-player game: 3.25 encounters per round, 1 animator credit per round.
HINT.SQUARES: The gap between Theoretical and Latent is the doomed-chase zone.
HINT.STRANDED: Cards held whose recipe cannot be completed from living hands.
HINT.AVATARS: Avatar #{{worst}} in red is the worst — maximin optimises that bar.
HINT.DECKS: Production is net-zero on its own level and −1 on the level above, so level 0 barely moves: death returns roughly as many level-0 cards as the new hand draws out.
HINT.TOLERANCE: How far from the baseline tempo still counts as acceptable.
HINT.PRICES: v1 priced the free-money game 3/6/9/12 and debt 1/2/4/8; v2 uses 1/2/4/8 for both. The debt curve doubles each level, the free-money curve adds 3.
HINT.PRICE_IN_DU: In June a card costs price × DU — at the final DU of {{du}} these are worth {{prices}}.
HINT.TECH_SHIFT: When someone produces a square at the top level, the next level opens and every price slides down a rung: the ladder becomes 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 8, then 0 / 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 8. Level 0 becomes free. Capped at 6 levels.
HINT.ROUNDS: Rounds are the only unit of time. Roughly 2 rounds pass per minute of real play, so the minute figure is information, not a setting.
HINT.TECH_SHIFT_RATIO: On each shift, every card whose price just fell to zero leaves the hand and goes back to its deck; the player draws replacements one level up. At 2:1 an odd card is surrendered, so hands shrink.

CHECK.NO_TECH_WALL: Never hit the unimplemented technological shift
CHECK.EVERYONE_PRODUCED: Every avatar produced at least once
CHECK.TECH_SHIFT_TIMING: Technological shift arrived at round {{floor}} or later
CHECK.TECH_SHIFT_NEVER: never happened — best production reached level {{reached}}, the shift needs level {{trigger}}

METRIC.RETIRED_NOTE: obsolete cards swapped up a level
METRIC.CEILING_NOTE: level {{level}} is the last one — {{count}} production(s) blocked there
METRIC.TECH_WALL_NOTE: {{count}} production(s) blocked — the shift is not implemented
